mina: Flagged during a demo: Roles > Effective preview sometimes shows that a role DOESN'T have the `route:modify` permission even though the role JSON (via API) includes it. Causing quota UI to grey out the override button. Repro steps: 1) open role preview for tenant:bigco 2) click "simulate user" on route /api/v1/produce 3) preview shows no modify permission but API returns it.
mina: curl I used:
```
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' 'https://console/api/v1/roles/role_789/preview?route=/api/v1/produce&tenant=bigco'
```
response: `{"effective":{"route:read":true,"route:modify":false}}` while `GET /api/v1/roles/role_789` shows `{"permissions":["route:read","route:modify"]}`
raj: that's rough. Any chance it's a UI bug mapping permission keys?
mina: looked at network tab - preview endpoint returns the falsey value. UI is faithful to payload.
olga: service owner here. Recent change: preview service started reading entitlements from `ent_cache_v2` when `permPreviewV2` flag is on for 50% of tenants. The cache TTL is long (5m) and we saw a race where role assignment updates write to primary store but not to the cache fast enough.
olga: short-term options: 1) invalidate cache on role write 2) lower TTL 3) make preview read-through to primary when feature-flagged tenants have a mismatch header.
raj: option 1 sounds easiest. But invalidation currently fires only for role create/delete, not updates.
mina: can we at least show a warning in the UI when preview payload contains stale_notice=true or metadata.cache_hit=false? Users get confused during demos.
olga: yes we can add `meta.cache_status` to the preview response. I'll add "meta":{"cache_status":"stale"} when TTL expiry or known divergence.
devops: please add telemetry event `perm_preview.cache_stale` with tenant and route tags. We'll autopage if rate > 20/min.
mike: also add a dashboard panel on console-payroll to track `perm_preview.*` and a small canary for `permPreviewV2` tenants so we can compare.
olga: I'll open PR: services/preview/* - 1) invalidate cache on role update, 2) add meta.cache_status, 3) emit telemetry, 4) lower TTL to 60s for canary tenants.
pxl-bot: ci queued for branch preview-cache-patch (build #7912)
raj: add unit + integration test that flips feature flag and asserts preview reflects role update within <120s. Also test pagination edge when preview requests include route param + scope param.
mina: thanks. After merge let's run a quick canary matrix: update role -> call preview -> verify UI shows modify/button enabled. I'll coordinate with support to notify tenants in the v2 cohort.
mike: good plan. Also add a temporary UI tooltip: "Preview may be stale during canary" behind `showPreviewCanaryNotice`.
olga: noted. PR will include UI flag and backend meta. Tagging @mike for review.
